insights.summary: H1 FY26 revenue more than doubled (+112% YoY to about ₹123 Cr) and net profit rose 81%, with box build at about 35% of revenue. The order book hit a record ₹463.5 Cr, about 3x FY25 revenue, helped by a ₹97.5 Cr ODM contract from an $8 billion US infrastructure firm. Management guided FY26 revenue of ₹250-280 Cr, 20%+ EBITDA and 15% ± 2 PAT margin, and is building a greenfield plant and looking at acquisitions.

what_changed.text: Record order book of ₹463.5 Cr, including a ₹97.5 Cr ODM contract and a 50,000-unit AI IoT order
AS9100D aerospace certification; prototype order from a Texas defence drone customer
FY26 revenue of ₹250-280 Cr and 40-50% growth
Preferential shares and warrants to fund a ₹1,000 Cr-capacity greenfield plant

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Up until now, Aimtron's philosophy has been to let the results speak for themselves.

analyst_questions.answer: More box build (with bought-in parts) raises cost of goods; management expects margins to hold around 15% PAT.
Deliberately cautious: long qualification and high working capital; defence to stay a small share of revenue.

analyst_questions.topic: Equity raise after calling equity precious
analyst_questions.answer: Warrants instead of loans to have capacity ready before moving to the main board; keeps headroom for an acquisition.
Current lines support about ₹450-500 Cr of revenue; the greenfield adds about ₹500 Cr more (about ₹100 Cr per SMT line).

red_flags.text: PAT margin fell versus H1 FY25 as cost of goods rose with box build.
Preferential warrants issued shortly after saying equity was too precious to dilute.
One ODM contract is about a fifth of the order book.

watch_next: H2 FY26 revenue in line with ₹250-280 Cr for the year
Box build above 50% of H2 revenue

business_snapshot.what_they_make: Electronics design and manufacturing: PCB assembly, box build and system integration, ODM product design (power electronics, telecom, IoT, automotive, MedTech)
business_snapshot.customers: Global and domestic OEMs, including a US data-centre infrastructure firm, Navratna PSUs and drone makers
business_snapshot.revenue_mix: About 60-65% domestic and 35-40% export in H1 FY26; box build about 35% of revenue
business_snapshot.demand_drivers: China-plus-one outsourcing, India's EMS growth, ODM demand, data centres and telecom upgrades
